title: Pink Halloween Party at Home, Last Call
intro: A Halloween party at home does not need a fog machine. It needs one good blanket on the sofa, velvet pumpkins that survive until Thanksgiving, cups nobody has to wash twice, and a pair of bunny ears for whoever forgot a costume. All of it ships from a US warehouse, which is the only reason it is still on this page in the second week of October.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on a chunky cream knit of pink velvet pumpkins, a pink faux fur throw, two pink velvet pillow covers, pink reusable party cups and fluffy pink bunny ears, with candy corn.
Woman in an oversized pink knit and leggings curled on a farmhouse sofa under a pink faux fur throw, pink velvet pumpkins on the coffee table, wearing fluffy bunny ears and holding a pink tumbler.
